title: Write a message
summary: PL/SQL: Write a message. Change the name.
introduction: An anonymous block has BEGIN and END. DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE writes a line for the client to show.

blocks.text: Use an Oracle practice database and SQL Developer Run Script or SQL*Plus. Run the whole block, including SET SERVEROUTPUT ON and the final slash. The result shown is DBMS_OUTPUT text.

blocks.title: Write a message

blocks.text: BEGIN starts the executable part. PUT_LINE adds the greeting to the server-output buffer.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Enable server output or the client may hide the message.

seo.title: PL/SQL: Write a message
seo.description: PL/SQL: Write a message. Change the name. Follow a small example and practise the idea.
